description: The Zambia Statistics Agency published the Series M housing and household descriptive tables of its 2022 Census of Population and Housing as a PDF of 515 pages. The census, the first fully digital one, counted 4,025,402 housing units and 4,085,698 households. Forty-seven tables give housing units by type, from huts to flats, and by roof, wall and floor material, occupancy and rooms. Household tables cover lighting energy, where 1,697,394 households use electricity and 481,097 solar, as well as cooking and heating energy. Water tables split piped water in the unit or on the plot, communal taps, protected boreholes, wells and surface water, for household use and for drinking. Other tables cover toilet type and location, household assets, refuse collection or dumping, and how units were acquired. Every table is by province, district and constituency, for the whole country and separately for rural and urban areas. Coverage is national. Format and access: free PDF uploaded in May 2026, no registration; the 2022 summary report and the 2010 housing report are also online. Licence: none found. Caveats: tables are printed in a PDF, and page headers carry the title of another report in the series; the NADA archive returned an empty page from the cloud; the round 1 visit read only the homepage. Simulation uses: roof and wall materials for flood and wind exposure by constituency, and grid versus solar lighting and water source shares for service planning. Related records: none closer in the catalogue.

name: ZamStats 2022 Census of Population and Housing Series M, Housing and Household Characteristics Descriptive Tables, with housing units by type, roof, wall and floor material, occupancy and rooms, and households by lighting energy (electricity, solar), cooking and heating energy, water for household use and drinking, toilet type and location, assets and refuse disposal, by province, district and constituency, rural and urban
schema_summary: Tables M1 to M47: M1-M3 housing units by type (hut, detached, semi-detached, terraced, flat); M4-M6 roof material; M7-M9 wall material; M10-M12 floor material; M13 occupancy; M14-M19 bedrooms and living rooms; M20-M22 lighting energy (electricity, firewood, candle, solar, lantern, torch); M23-M25 cooking energy; M26-M28 heating energy; M29-M31 water for household use (piped into unit, piped on plot, neighbour, communal tap, protected borehole, protected or unprotected well, surface water); M32-M34 drinking water; M35-M37 toilet type and share with proper toilet; M38-M40 toilet inside or outside and shared; M41-M43 household assets; M44-M46 refuse disposal (regular or irregular collection, burning, dumping, burying); M47 how housing units were acquired. Each by province, district and constituency; national, rural, urban.
